reason: Accepting a self-signed HTTPS certificate in a context (`ignoreHTTPSErrors`), which these tests need for their TLS origins. Chromium refuses `acceptInsecureCerts` with Unsupported, because its certificate override applies to the whole browser (as browsercontext-add-cookies' CO-041 does)
The test evaluates in the blocked iframe's isolated world, which stock WebKit lacks (`isolatedWorlds` is unsupported)
